environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) running as root. SELinux is in permissive mode (setenforce 0). The application binary runs directly on the host with no containerization. The secret file at /etc/myapp/secrets/api_key is readable. Network access is unrestricted (no WAF, no rate limiting). The application is exposed directly on port 8080 via a public IP with no reverse proxy adding jitter.

config.network: direct public exposure on :8080, no ALB/NLB, no rate limiting
